scope: Targeted verification of the supplied proposal, project records, and selected primary sources. This is not a systematic novelty search.

proposal.title: Research Directions: Few-Shot OCT Diagnosis of Rare Retinal Diseases
proposal.access: Read in the T3 collaborative browser after Lam authenticated. Proposal text and all five idea descriptions were inspected. Only section folding and browser navigation were used; document text was not edited.

open_gaps_observed.idea: Cost-effectiveness benchmark: generative augmentation vs. foundation-model few-shot
Rigorous re-evaluation: leakage, confidence intervals, real-clinic test set
Open-set detection: flag an unknown rare disease instead of forcing a known class
One conditional generator for all rare classes vs. one GAN per disease
External validation on local clinical OCT (e.g., a Vietnamese hospital)

claims_not_adopted_as_verified_findings: High novelty and high feasibility ratings are judgments, not empirical statistics.
Public RETFound weights do not establish low compute or review cost; the official checkpoint has an access gate.
RETFound label efficiency at ten percent of labels is task-specific, not a guaranteed result for these five rare diseases.
An illustrative clinical scan-count range is not a powered patient-level sample-size calculation.
A first-ever clinic-sourced validation claim and predictions of journal tier were not established.
OCTDL categories cannot silently replace or extend the existing nine-class label space.

primary_sources.title: Feasibility study to improve deep learning in OCT diagnosis of rare retinal diseases with few-shot classification
primary_sources.authors: Yoo TK; Choi JY; Kim HK
primary_sources.read_scope: Full XML body present. Dataset methods, frozen-backbone/250-epoch description, augmentation and expert review, Tables 3 and 4.

verified_items.backbone: Convolutional layers left frozen; final fully connected layer trained.
verified_items.checkpoint_selection: The project final-head convention is not established by the paper.

primary_sources.title: Improvement Strategies for Few-Shot Learning in OCT Image Classification of Rare Retinal Diseases
primary_sources.read_scope: Abstract and full-text methodology. Supports the existence of a U-GAT-IT/balancing/attention extension; its headline accuracy is not used as this project's result.

primary_sources.title: Diffusion with Adversarial Fine-Tuning for Improving Rare Retinal Disease Diagnosis
primary_sources.read_scope: Author-repository abstract and bibliographic record only; full experimental methods not audited.
primary_sources.verified_observation: Class-aware diffusion, attention and adversarial fine-tuning are used for rare OCT synthesis and a ResNet18 downstream task.

primary_sources.title: Boosting foundation models for rare eye disease diagnosis via a multimodal text-to-image generative framework
primary_sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and Results paragraphs on multiple foundation models, OCT tasks, rare disease tasks and external datasets. Not an exhaustive cost or methods audit.
primary_sources.verified_observation: Synthetic augmentation of retinal foundation models and external evaluation already exist; a general first-ever novelty claim is not justified by this report.

primary_sources.title: A foundation model for generalizable disease detection from retinal images
primary_sources.read_scope: Full XML body present. Pretraining dataset descriptions, label-efficiency examples and reference 34.
primary_sources.verified_observation: The OCT pretraining corpus includes images attributed to reference 34, which identifies Kermany et al., Cell 2018, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2018.02.010.
primary_sources.unverified: Exact file/patient overlap between the pretraining data and this project's test manifest.

primary_sources.title: RETFound Nature OCT official model card and repository
primary_sources.read_scope: Access gate, model-card license and official repository access instructions.
primary_sources.unverified: This project's access approval, executable checkpoint compatibility and measured adaptation cost. Weights were not downloaded.

primary_sources.title: OCTDL: Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset for Image-Based Deep Learning Methods
primary_sources.read_scope: Full XML body present. Table 2, Data Records, category/condition descriptions and patient-ID fields.
primary_sources.unverified: Dataset files have not been downloaded, locally counted, or mapped to this project's nine classes.
